title: Abbas Aa ke Dekho
body:
zainab ki ye sada thi zaalim sata rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho zaalim sata rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
meri rida sina par mujhko dikha rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat ke saron se chinti thi jab ridayein
aale nabi ne di thi us dam tujhe sadayein
ab khaake karbala se sar ko chupa rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naazon se jo pali thi bhaiya teri bhatiji
ab hai sitam ke zad par haye sakina meri
usko sata rahe hai durre laga rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein aag jis dam zaalim laga rahe thay
tujhko madad ki khaatir hum sab bula rahe thay
sajjad ka bhi bistar aada jala rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na-mehramon mein zainab sar nange ab yahan hai
zaamin meri rida ke na jaane tu kahan hai
be-pardagi pe meri aada rula rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
salman ek qayamat karbobala mein guzri
sun kar sada e zainab ghazi ki laash larzi
meri rida sina par mujhko dikha rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
author: Salman Rizvi
